rv.q: The '80s gets a loving tribute all right, and it inarguably needed one.
This production is as pleasurable, polished and professionally produced as any show in Chicago.

With its soulful vocals, timeless melodies, and heartfelt lyrics, BET's The Time Machine: A Tribute To The '80s is a thrilling roller-coaster ride you don't want to miss. ⭐⭐⭐⭐ Black Ensemble Theater The Time Machine: A Tribute To The 80s Written and Directed by Daryl D. Brooks Choreographed by Christopher Chase Carter Extended to May 12, 2024.
The Time Machine: A Tribute to the 80’s is more than just a musical revue; it's a time capsule capturing the raw energy, cultural impact, and enduring legacy of 80s music.
"Time Machine: A Tribute to the Eighties” is a celebration of Black music excellence that leaves you feeling good from head to toe.
The first act is marvelous; the second act is sublime!

cn.t: Critics praise this energetic jukebox musical for its vibrant celebration of '80s Black music history, with strong performances and infectious songs that get audiences dancing, though the thin narrative frame serves mainly as a vehicle for the hits.
